t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The advice was emphasising the role that the colour of the gnome plays in the game. That certain colours of gnomes can give more points, so look out for that. So for example, if the blue gnome consistently gives a high number of points, keep picking that colour gnome. If the gnome you pick doesn't give you a high number, then try pick another colour gnome and check for any patterns. The advice also noted that colours are paired together, so blue is paired with green for example.

vb_textbox.text: The gnomes are paired by colour. The pink gnome is paired with the brown gnome for example, so look out for the colour pairings. There seems to be one coloured gnome in each pairing that tends to get more points than the other. If one colour of gnome  (such as brown for example) consistently seems to get a high number of points, keep picking that gnome. If you aren't sure (or if one gnome keeps getting a low number of points),  on the X1 rounds, pick the other coloured gnome in that pairing and see if it gives you more points. The X5 rounds can be useful in showing whether the coloured gnome picked is the one that can yield the most points. Overall, look out for patterns with the colour of gnome picked. One colour usually receives more points than the other.
